title: Combined Metaheuristic Algorithm and Radiomics Strategy for the Analysis of Neuroanatomical Structures in Schizophrenia and Schizoaffective Disorders
Schizophrenia and Schizoaffective Are Psychotic Mood Disorders
abstract: CME Educational Objectives 1. Review the historical reasons for splitting functional psychotic illness into “schizophrenia,” and “schizoaffective disorder,” and “psychotic mood disorder.” 2. Describe the modern data that link “schizophrenia,” and “schizoaffective disorder,” and “psychotic mood disorder” into a single illness with a spectrum of severity. 3. Cite the potential to harm patients by splitting functional psychotic illness into “schizophrenia,” and “schizoaffective disorder,” and “psychotic mood disorder.”

title: Neuroanatomical Features That Predict Response to Electroconvulsive Therapy Combined With Antipsychotics in Schizophrenia: A Magnetic Resonance Imaging Study Using Radiomics Strategy
venue: Frontiers in Psychiatry Frontiers Media SA
